Materials you get from your instructor, not here

Some of the materials named in your syllabus are copyrighted print publications. The Reading Lab does not host them, and that is deliberate rather than an oversight.

  • Scoreboost for TABE, Reading Level M

    Copyrighted workbook your instructor provides. Page ranges appear in the course roadmap.

  • TABE Mastery Reading, Level M

    Copyrighted student book your instructor provides. Page ranges appear in the course roadmap.

  • Pretest and TABE practice tests

    Assessment materials administered by your instructor under program conditions.

  • Answer keys and the Teacher's Manual

    Instructor-only materials. These are never published to students in any format.

Where graded work goes

Nothing you do in the Reading Lab is graded or recorded. Practice here as often as you want, then submit official work in Brightspace. Assignments, submissions, attendance, announcements, and grades are all in Brightspace.
